title: The Conservatory Shift (-5)
description:
An anonymous letter was recovered from the victim's coat pocket.
The letters were shifted backward by 5 positions.
question:
Decrypt this message:

YMJ BIFUMX NX NSIYMJ XIFI
acceptable_answer_format:
Type the decoded sentence exactly.

Example:
THE KEY IS SAFE
accepted_answers: THE WEAPON IS IN THE SAFE
the weapon is in the safe
hints: Each letter was shifted backward by 5 positions.
To restore the original text, shift each letter forward by 5 positions.
solution_explanation: Shifting each letter forward by 5 steps (Y->T, M->H, J->E) produces: 'THE WEAPON IS IN THE SAFE'.
